data.desc: ARS Pharma is a biopharmaceutical company developing and commercializing treatments that help at-risk patients and their caregivers treat and prevent severe allergic reactions. The company is commercializing neffy (epinephrine nasal spray), the only needle-free epinephrine approved by the U.S. Food & Drug Administration, for the emergency treatment of Type I allergic reactions, including anaphylaxis, in adults and children weighing 33 lbs. (15 kg) or more. In the European Union, the product is marketed as EURneffy , the only needle-free epinephrine product authorized by the European Commission, for the emergency treatment of allergic reactions, including anaphylaxis, in adults and children four years of age and older weighing 15 kg or more. The product is also marketed as in China.
